added.summary: A model program's `material` takes a procedural `surface`: layers of noise, ridged, craters, strata, stripes, panels, rivets, veins, edges (convex wear) and cavities (dirt), cooked deterministically into base-colour, metallic-roughness, normal and emissive maps on a fresh atlas at `density` texels per metre. Props, pickups and displaced rocks carry patterned, lit surfaces with no painted image; `og model preview` draws them as the cook writes them.
